scope: A blank contract is rendered as PENDING, never invented — on BOTH desktop surfaces. MFL records only the SALARY on a waiver/FCFS award and leaves contractStatus/contractYear/contractInfo empty. The legacy Roster Workbench (site/rosters/roster_workbench.js, the surface wired to MESSAGE7) had no contract-unknown notion and was chipping such a row EXPIRED — a state MFL never claimed — and dropping its salary out of the cap total. It now mirrors FO v2: a PENDING pill, "pending" contract-shape cells, no Expired label and no risk chip, and the real salary still counted against the cap. The worker, both clients and the WW stamp's blank-only write guard now share one definition of "MFL has not said", so a pending row is always stampable.
